map.text_display.lobby.changelog:
# 🛠 GLOBAL MAP UPDATE

## ⚙ Technical part and optimization

* **Global refactoring:** The map code has been completely rewritten. A solid foundation for future updates has been created, optimization has been significantly increased, and adaptation for multiplayer has been improved.
* **Animated Java:** The map has been migrated to the new version of the library (`v1.10.0`).
* **Engine mechanics:** Player pushing and **sliding** on bananas have been moved to the "Delta" Motion library.
* **Compatibility:** Custom functionality has been added to support shaders in the resource pack together with the *Sodium* mod (a special bridge mod must be installed).
* Shader versions in the resource pack have been updated (the transition from version `1.21.11` to `26.1.2` has been made).

## 🎮 Gameplay and game balance

* **New roles:** The long-awaited ability to play as two or more animatronics simultaneously has appeared.
* **ym_complex:** The gameplay in this location has been completely reworked.
* **Killer Rebalance:** The animatronic's abilities have been changed (including a complete rework of the player visibility mechanic).
* **Ventilation:** Ventilation shafts have been added to some areas of the map - you can now take shortcuts or use them for cover.
* **Match Customization:** Gameplay modifiers have been added (several to choose from). Events, bonuses, and hints can now be customized or disabled completely.
* **Dynamic Atmosphere:** Random weather and time of day changes added (configurable in the lobby).
* **Minor Improvements:**
* Crawling no longer requires holding down the CTRL key.
* The lights now temporarily go out while the animatronic's second ability is active.
* The number of required generator diskettes has been reduced from 5 to 3.
* The animatronic's attack direction now depends strictly on the direction it is facing.



## 🚪 New Escape Methods

* **Helicopter Escape:** New items have been added - a canister and an ignition key, needed to repair and start the helicopter.
* **Portal Escape:** A completely new escape route. The mechanic is one-time: you need to turn on power at the electrical substation, insert the blue keycard and activate the terminal.

## 📦 New items and interactive objects

* ⚡ **Electrical Substation:** A new large object for interaction on the map.
* 🌀 **Artifact Table:** Allows you to upgrade basic items (for example, it upgrades a regular physics gun).
* 🔫 **RPG:** A secret weapon with infinite ammunition. Instantly destroys everyone in a small radius.
* 🌡 **Stimpack:** Adds one additional heart when used.
* 🧭 **Prototype #1:** Slows down time for whoever holds it.
* 👁 **X-ray Scanner:** A single-use device that highlights an animatronic for 15 seconds.
* 💨 **Smoke Bomb:** Creates a dense curtain at the point of impact for several seconds.
* 🔔 **Bell:** Makes various funny sounds when pressed with LMB/RMB.
* 🧲 **Magnet:** Helps retrieve valuable items from hard-to-reach storm drains.
* ⚡ **Taser:** Has been reworked and is now capable of completely eliminating players.
* 🧲 **Physgun:** Reworked. Now can effectively knock back both survivors and animatronics. Also added its improved **Blue version**.
* 🛠 **Breakthrough Tools:**
* **Hammer:** For opening yellowed safes with brute force.
* **Shovel:** For digging up piles of earth.
* **Screwdriver:** Allows you to unscrew the ventilation grilles in the complex.
* **Wrench:** Needed to dismantle the iron cover near the elevator on the 1st floor (to install the battery).


* 📦 **Frozen Items:** New type of loot. To use them, you first need to defrost them in the microwave on the *ym_complex* map.
* 📼 **Quest Loot:** Added multi-colored fuses and floppy disks.

## 📺 Interface (UI), Visuals and Cosmetics

* **Skin System:** Animatronics now have skins! The first 3 skins have been added: "Custom", "V1" and "V2".
* **Match Start:** The role presentation has become much more epic - instead of the usual text, a beautiful card is now displayed on the screen, and the animatronic chooses one of random threatening animations.
* **New HUD:** Health hearts have been moved from the center to the lower left corner. In the lobby, the health bar is hidden for everyone, and during the match it also disappears for animatronics.
* **TAB Improvements:** New status icons have been added (for example, an eye icon for a player behind cameras and a skull for dead players).
* **UI Elements:**
* The background (tooltip) has been redesigned when hovering over items.
* The description of items that require a long press now displays the exact duration.
* The frame for status effects (poisoning, regeneration) has been redesigned to match the general style of the custom inventory.
* Updated game mode icons.
* Notification text (for example, "You escaped") now flies out with a smooth animation.


* **Model Animations:**
* Smooth interpolation between animatronic animations has been added.
* Impact and shock animations for animatronics have been reworked.
* Player sitting at monitors in the guard house, now has a full a computer animation.
* Security cameras "go to sleep" (turn off animation) if no one is watching them.


* **Economy and Item Balance:** Bananas now stack up to 64 and their texture has been updated.
* **Boosty:** Doubled the amount of available cosmetics. The texture of Boost subscriptions has been updated, and a neat call to support the author has been added to the sponsors' stand.

## 🔊 Sound accompaniment

* 13 new sounds have been added to the soundpad.
* The playlist of radio stations on maps has been updated.
* The sound effects of the environment and some objects have been adjusted and refined.

## 🏡 Lobby and Tutorial

* **Interactive:** A full-fledged board mini-game "Four in a Row" has been added to the lobby.
* A functional **Admin Panel** has been added (activated by pressing the `G` key).
* The geometry of the settings room has been slightly changed.
* A secret pistol can now be found in the lobby.
* A life-size cardboard figure of Ryo Yamada has appeared in the corridor near the representative's office.
* **Tutorial:** The tutorial in the lobby has been completely redesigned taking into account the new items and alternative escape routes.

---

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Fixed a bug where one or more players could accidentally become spectators right at the start of a match.
* Players can no longer activate other players' keys if they are simply in the hands of another survivor.
* Crawling now works correctly inside the lobby area.
* The Sands of Time font is now displayed correctly.
* The metal detector model is now stuck to the floor.
* Added new bugs to give more room to fix.
* Security booth doors now play a "jamming" animation if you try to open them without a key (and added a small delay between retries).
* Monitors in the security booth no longer get stuck with an exclamation point after the animatronic's second ability has completed.
* The spinning player head (choosing who animatronic) to a random search.
* The successful escape message is now visible only to the escaped player, not to everyone at once.
* The unnatural crunching sound of bones when falling from a height has been removed for the player playing as the animatronic.
* The death of a player or their kill by the animatronic is now correctly logged as a text message in the general chat.
* Deceased players in spectator mode now see each other's nicknames.
* The compass-locator (Locatorbar) is now activated strictly during the use of the ability to illuminate.
* The display of textures by pixels near the left door of the car and in a number of other places has been adjusted.

map.text_display.lobby_connect_four.rule:
2 players
Players take turns
Click an available cell in a column to drop a disc
The disc always falls to the lowest free slot in the chosen column
The first to line up 4 discs in a row wins:
— horizontally, | vertically, or / diagonally
If a player moves too far from the table, the game resets
If the board fills up with no winner, it's a draw

map.text_display.ui.map_desc:
Two modes: "Hide and Seek" and "Escape".

In "Hide and Seek", just hide for a set time (no safe zones spawn).

In "Escape", flight is necessary; leave the complex at any cost.

Future update: "Nextbot" mode, escaping from a pursuing AI.
map.text_display.ui.escape_1_desc: Escape using the complex's turbo descent. Becomes available after you insert 3 fuses in order into the generator on floor -1, remove the panel on floor 1 with a wrench and insert the elevator battery, and route power at the substation. Press the 🔻 button once all escape conditions are met
map.text_display.ui.escape_2_desc:
A routine, fairly simple path: find the key to the Representative's Office (inside you'll find the key to the Director's Office). In that office a safe awaits, holding the keycard to the security booth, where you just pull the lever (after routing power to the main gates) to raise them and escape.
To route power to the main gates you also need to insert all the disks in the generator room
map.text_display.ui.escape_3_desc: A somewhat tricky escape requiring 3 disks, 1 lever, the helicopter manual, a fuel canister, and the ignition key. Disks may hide in lockers, safes, or outside. Insert them in order in the generator room, and insert the lever at the substation to raise the gates to the helicopter
map.text_display.ui.escape_4_desc: A one-time escape. All you need is the blue keycard and power routed to "Portal" at the substation. Then go down to floor -2, insert the keycard, and hold the button. At this moment you're very vulnerable to the animatronic and to players who could ruin your escape. After a successful escape, the portal becomes unavailable

ORDER

I hereby order
to purchase tea (lots of it)
on behalf of HQ rep.


Mart   Martynenko V.R.
map.text_display.paper_2:
Operation 'Observer'

• 07.04.20██ — Arrival of H-series animatrons
• 15.04.20██ — First recognition failure
• 18.04.20██ — Elevator incident, injured technician
• 21.04.20██ — Forbidden to mention "code 0-C"

It's all recorded. Nobody reads it.
I'll leave copies... in case someone decides to understand what's happening.
map.text_display.paper_3:
Entry #1427.

They had protocols, cameras, specialists.
I warned them. Wrote. Sent.
They left me in the archive. Thinking I'm just a "paper man".

...They forgot the archive holds all the keys.
map.text_display.paper_4:
To ISO-9 Management

Once again, providing you with 'Gel Phase Platform' testing protocols was an act of goodwill — not a reason to call it 'your' invention in official docs.

Expecting removal of incorrect wording.

— Legal Dept MOVEMENT SCIENCE

to replace the signature

on behalf of HQ rep.

Mrt    Martynenko V.R.

map.text_display.guide_book.introduction: Welcome. If you're reading this, an isolation protocol has been declared in the complex. This book gathers critically important data on how the facility's systems work and on emergency evacuation methods. Remember: your life depends on you, and all that — in short, don't do anything stupid
map.text_display.guide_book.page1_text:
The complex is huge, and many paths are blocked. Use the gear you find wisely:

• ꁇ Hammer: break open iron crates to get the item inside

• ꁑ Shovel: check dirt mounds outside — resources are often hidden there

• ꁉ Magnet: lets you pull metal items out from under the storm-drain grates in the asphalt

• ꁐ Screwdriver: remove ventilation hatch covers for stealthy movement

• ꁒ Electrical Tape: needed to repair the electronic panels at the Substation and to fix the generator in the basement
map.text_display.guide_book.page2_text:
Besides tools, you can find other useful things in the complex:

• ꁄ Compressed fuel canister: needed to fuel the helicopter

• ꁈ Ignition key: needed to start the helicopter

• ꁆ Colored fuses: needed for the elevator's turbo descent (must be arranged per the diagram)

• ꁅ Elevator battery: a powerful energy source for the elevator (inserted into the panel by the elevator on floor 1)
map.text_display.guide_book.page3_text1: All evacua- tion systems are powered down. Before you rush to the exit, visit the substation outside
map.text_display.guide_book.page3_text2: 1. Use electrical tape to restore the contacts (without it, interaction is blocked)
map.text_display.guide_book.page3_text3:
2. Use the switch to choose where to route power: the Main Gates, the Turbo Descent, or the Lab on floor -2

3. Remember: there's only enough power for one target at a time
map.text_display.guide_book.page4_text1: 1. Main Gates: route power to the «Main Gates», find the red card (in the Director's safe), and activate the lever in the security booth
map.text_display.guide_book.page4_text2: 2. Turbo Descent (floor -1): Route power to the «Turbo Descent». Find the ꁓ wrench and unscrew the panel by the elevator on floor 1. Insert the elevator battery there. Go down to the generator room (you need the ꁔ yellow card) and arrange the ꁆ 3 fuses per the diagram (found in bioengineering on floor 2). Once activated, enter the elevator and press the 🔻 button
map.text_display.guide_book.page5_text: 3. Helicopter: find the fuel canister, the ignition key, and the helicopter manual. In the generator room (floor -1) insert the ꁕ 3 disks in the correct order, and the ꁖ lever at the Substation to open the pad's gates
map.text_display.guide_book.page6_text1: This is a unique, one-time escape method for *one* survivor (so be careful)
map.text_display.guide_book.page6_text2: 1. Route power to the Lab from the substation
map.text_display.guide_book.page6_text3:
2. Find the blue keycard

3. Go down to floor -2, insert the card, and press the button. Hold it for exactly 10 seconds while the system stabilizes
map.text_display.guide_book.page7_text:
There are three types of safes: key-locked, code-locked, and jammed (opened with a hammer; they have a darker tint)

The basement safe code is split: the first half is with the Archivist, the second is on the back wall of the substation

Safes are guaranteed to contain important escape items, so you should definitely open them
map.text_display.guide_book.page8_text:
Some items are locked. For example, on floor -2 use the buttons to balance the pressure in the pipe

In bioengineering, a color code blinks in a loop on the monitor — repeat it on the buttons to open the safe

Frozen items must be thawed in the microwave in the kitchen (careful, it's very loud!)
map.text_display.guide_book.page9_text1:
Most offices require keys, which appear in random places

If you get confused, every floor of the complex has a stand with a map of the complex and hints about the offices on that floor. They'll help you find your way
map.text_display.guide_book.page9_text2: Use ventilation shafts for stealthy movement and shortcuts — a screwdriver is needed to open them
map.text_display.guide_book.page10_text:
Most items require holding RMB for a few seconds to use — for example, the first aid kit or the defibrillator. Read the item descriptions

If your ally dies, you can use the defibrillator. It revives an ally with one heart. Important: first aid kits and bandages no longer work on them afterward
map.text_display.guide_book.page11_text1: Rumor has it you can obtain an artifact in the complex that controls time... but you'll need to perform certain actions for that. Hints about it can be found around the complex itself
map.text_display.guide_book.page11_text2: Read on: how a Boosty subscription helps speed up updates and the release of new maps ...
